title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: An agent run makes 6 model calls in total. A 3,000-token tool result is added to the context right after call 2 and is never removed. The program re-sends the whole context on every call. In how many of the 6 calls is that tool result part of the model's input?

On Monday your assistant told a student that the lathe needs a safety briefing. On Friday, in a new chat, the student says "as you told me Monday" and the assistant has no idea what they mean. Which explanation is correct?

options.text: The model's memory of Monday faded because several days had passed
The new chat began with an empty context and Monday was never saved
The context window was too small to keep a whole chat from Monday
The model had not yet learned from Monday's chat when Friday began

items.stem: A student asks what fault code "E-47" means on the vinyl cutter. The manual has a line reading "E-47: blade carriage jammed." Which search is the most dependable way to find that line?

options.text: Embedding search alone, because it understands what the question means
Asking the model to answer from memory without searching the manual
Keyword search, because the exact code string is the useful signal
Loading the longest chunk, because it holds the most information

items.stem: Your makerspace has about 2,000 pages of manuals. In one or two sentences, why is it better for the assistant to retrieve a few relevant pages for each question than to put all the manuals in every request?
A long agent run is close to the context window's limit. Name one thing the program can do to let the run continue without losing the important points.
